end.method: Fine minus baseline after averaging each aligned 2x2 fine block onto its 250 m footprint; only baseline floodplain cells whose four fine children are all floodplain. Dry cells included; mixed or differing masks excluded.

peak.method: Fine minus baseline after averaging each aligned 2x2 fine block onto its 250 m footprint; only baseline floodplain cells whose four fine children are all floodplain. Dry cells included; mixed or differing masks excluded.

original_source_identity.source_scope: Historical source metadata and process identities are evidence; portable replay never resolves or reads these paths.

method.bounds: Float32 half-ULP bounds quantify serialized raster storage only; common-footprint bounds propagate all four fine-cell errors through their mean. CSV water uses a separate 12-significant-digit rounding bound. These are not discretization or floating-point arithmetic error bounds.
method.day12: Both day12 and day20 native fields are replayed from retained original output bytes.
method.deposition: Checkpoint deposited_mass is cumulative source-integrated mineral mass. The pre-remap raster event_deposit is porous thickness; its native-cell-area integral times rho_s*(1-porosity)=1590 kg/m3 is remaining mineral mass.
method.events: Capture and abandonment are reconstructed separately on each native grid by comparing its pre-remap snapshot mask with the checkpoint centerline capsule mask. Counts and physical areas are reported; no continuous swept-bank interpretation.
method.fullsolid: Current bed+bank+suspension inventory is independently reaggregated. Initial full-solid reference is inferred independently for each grid from its recorded residual, not regenerated; equality across grids is not required.
method.grid_comparison: Native-grid integrals use each case's own sampled floodplain mask. Local field differences use equal physical 250 m square footprints only where the baseline cell and all four fine children are floodplain; fine cell averages preserve area integrals. Mask disagreements and excluded squares are reported, not treated as matching cells.
method.normalization: Both cases retain C=.003 and concentration_scale=.001. Prescribed upstream water and sediment inputs use each actual parameter set and 20000-interval Simpson integration of Q^2.5. Gross inputs exclude outflow, recycling and signed bed forcing.
method.phase: Peak day12 and end day20 rasters precede first remap; checkpoint follows remap. Channel CSV lacks its own clock and is paired by the frozen snapshot writer.
method.replay: Portable replay repeats the retained terminal auditor arithmetic from archived bytes. It reaggregates current checkpoint water, suspended classes, and bed-plus-suspension-plus-bank inventory; initial water/full-solid references remain inferred, not regenerated. Historical process observations are preserved evidence and are not re-observed; the model is not rerun.
method.suspension: Initial suspended inventory is zero in the frozen initializer; the suspension-plus-deposition residual is independently recomputed from arrays and checkpoint source/external/correction ledgers.
method.water: Post-remap water is independently reaggregated from native unmapped raster cells and actual post-remap 1-D control areas. Initial water is inferred independently from each ledger, not regenerated.

scope: Completed first-flood floodplain-grid sensitivity, dx250 versus dx125 with common 250 m channel nodes. No spatial-convergence order, later-flood or manuscript claim.
